changes: Enemy destination callouts: choose another area, then 1, 2 or 3+ to report movements such as “2 enemies going to Farm”. Gilneas Mine/Mines now appears as one destination.
EFC route callouts: Ramp, Graveyard and Tunnel in Warsong Gulch; Ramp, Graveyard and Water in Twin Peaks. Buttons work in midfield and during combat.

Highground: `/hg config general` → Battleground → Quick callout panel. Standalone Battlegrounds: `/hgbg config` → Quick callout panel. Enable Enemy destination callouts and/or EFC route callouts; both start off.
notice: Restart WoW after updating; this release adds an addon file, so /reload is not enough. CurseForge files may still be in moderation.
